record.one_liner: Generative image and video model platform (Higgsfield) exposing image/video models via API and an MCP server
record.auth_notes: Credentials are a key ID and secret created in Higgsfield Console, sent in the Authorization header as Key ID:SECRET. No OAuth documented.
record.access_notes: Docs say to create an account at the console and generate API credentials from the dashboard. No free-tier or plan requirement was stated in the pages read; billing is per generation in credits, so the free path is unverified.
record.api_notes: Async REST generation endpoints per model (request_id, status_url, cancel_url). Coverage is limited to generation models; account/history endpoints were not verified.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve key plus documented REST API. Billing is per generation; exact free allowance not confirmed.

evidence.quote: Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
Generate your API credentials from the dashboard
Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account.
No API keys to manage or configure.
